policy: Add-only. Every review-queue gloss is kept unchanged; this file adds the English evidence English Wiktionary supplies: resolved form-of lemmas, close variants, translation-table equivalents, usage examples with English translations, and romanizations. Definitions are ranked (own sense corroborated by a translation table, then own sense in Wiktionary order with obsolete/archaic/rare senses last, then resolved lemma, close variant, translation equivalent). The lead candidate is a reviewer's starting point; nothing is selected or approved.
